title: ParameterRecord
description: One tensor in a checkpoint's payload, addressed by offset and length (DESIGN.md § 6.2). Its path is unique among the records of its checkpoint (DESIGN.md § 2.3), and offset + length <= the checkpoint's file_size with offset a multiple of its alignment (DESIGN.md § 6.2); ESS states neither here. On disk a record is identified by its path and belongs to the checkpoint whose manifest contains it, and parameter_record_id and checkpoint_id are derived from those and not written in the record (DESIGN.md § 6.2).

offset.description: Absolute byte offset of the tensor from the start of the file, a multiple of the checkpoint's alignment (DESIGN.md § 6.2).

length.description: Length in bytes, equal to the product of `shape` times `dtype.size_bytes`, so tensor bytes are never reinterpreted (DESIGN.md § 6.2).

modelspec.checkpoint.DType.title: DType
modelspec.checkpoint.DType.description: A tensor element type and its size in bytes; `f32` is the only M0/M1 dtype (DESIGN.md § 2.2).

modelspec.checkpoint.ParameterPath.title: ParameterPath
modelspec.checkpoint.ParameterPath.description: A stable canonical parameter path such as `TinyMLP.fc1.weight` (DESIGN.md § 2.3).

modelspec.checkpoint.Shape.title: Shape
modelspec.checkpoint.Shape.description: A tensor shape; each dimension is a positive integer and rank 0 is a scalar (DESIGN.md § 2.2).
